summary: Helena NF site in Jefferson Co., Montana, near the later Strawberry Butte tower; named as a possible 1940 station site; listed as removed.

facts.status_note: The listing marks the lookout as removed.

events.note: Independent item of July 1, 1939, quoted by the listing: Shingle Butte an important detection and control point, scheduled for improvement.
Independent item of February 29, 1940: a new permanent lookout planned in the McClellan creek area, on Shingle Butte or a mountain one mile south; surveys to decide.

notes_for_editor: Built date and form (tower, cab or camp) are not in the sources read. The listing gives 'Removed' with no date and no account of how the lookout came down. The 1939 and 1940 items are as quoted on the Forest Lookouts pages (dates checked 2026-10-21: July 1, 1939; February 29, 1940; March 26, 1940); the Independent originals were not checked. The March 26, 1940 item on the Strawberry Butte page says a 60-foot tower and cabin were to be built that summer, and the story reports that as the plan; the register describes the Strawberry Lookout as a 65' Aermotor tower, so the two heights differ and the story does not say what was actually built. The record point 46.49354, -111.91888 lies about 2 km north of the Strawberry Butte record point (46.47551, -111.91540), which fits 'near'. The listing and NHLR both say Helena National Forest; the story keeps that name.
